transcript.text: Hey everyone, since we're moving the public GraphQL API from pilot to general production traffic on Monday, I want to make sure we've addressed everything on the readiness review checklist before I finalize the production API policy. The current draft has 300 requests per minute with a burst of 30, allows schema introspection, query depth 12, and no tenant-specific rate tiers. The checklist calls out tenant rate tiers, dependency-failure behavior, query controls, and customer-specific limits as items we need to cover. I'd like to go through each of these — does anyone have concerns or updates on where we stand?
